$comment: The contract between briefs/ and the driver. For each step: which brief to send, which contract the answer is validated against, which Superpowers skills the brief invokes, and every {{PLACEHOLDER}} the driver must substitute before sending. Nothing here names a project — the values come from the consuming repo's .claude/harness.json and from the run.

skills.superpowers:writing-plans: turns an approved spec into a decomposition with no placeholders
skills.superpowers:systematic-debugging: the first step on a bug: reproduce, isolate, prove red
skills.superpowers:subagent-driven-development: builds a plan one task at a time, a fresh helper per task and a review between them
skills.superpowers:test-driven-development: red before green, inside every task
skills.superpowers:verification-before-completi: observation before any claim of done
skills.superpowers:requesting-code-review: an independent reviewer on the finished change
skills.superpowers:receiving-code-review: acting on findings with rigour rather than agreement

notInvoked.superpowers:brainstorming: it waits on a person, so an unattended step cannot invoke it. The approved spec stands in for it.

facts.TICKET: the ticket body, verbatim, including its acceptance criteria and its type labels
facts.DESIGN: the approved design or spec this ticket builds to, and where that approval is recorded
facts.PROGRAMME_BRIEF: the programme's locked decisions, open questions and what shipped recently — the brief, never the whole state file
facts.PREMISE_REPORT: what the driver's premise gather printed: each path the ticket cites, marked present, moved or absent
facts.IN_FLIGHT: open pull requests, remote branches and live claims that touch the files this ticket names
facts.PROJECT_FACTS: the consuming project's facts from .claude/harness.json: trunk branch, gate commands, coding-standards path, the component kit, the design law

facts.PLAN_TASK: one task from the plan step's answer: its title, files, tests and risks
facts.PROJECT_FACTS: the consuming project's facts from .claude/harness.json: gate commands, changelog convention, the component kit
facts.STANDARDS: the coding-standards document this project holds a change to
facts.SURFACE_RULES: the project's rules for a screen — empty when this task touches none

facts.APPROVED: what was approved, and where that approval is recorded
facts.RENDERS: the renders taken from the real route in this run: name, file, theme
facts.ROUTE: the route the renders were taken from, and how to reach it authed

facts.DIFF: the change under review, against the trunk it will merge into
facts.RENDERS: the renders of every screen the change touches, both themes — empty when it touches none
facts.ROUND: which review round this is: 1 or 2
facts.PROJECT_FACTS: the consuming project's facts from .claude/harness.json: the design law, the component kit, the gate commands

facts.BLOCKERS: the blockers from the review step's answer, each with its id, file, line, summary and proposed fix
facts.DIFF: the change as it stands, against the trunk it will merge into
facts.ROUND: which fix round this is: 1 or 2
